strategy.overview: Hokus Pokus rewards repeated trips through the side spinner and careful completion of the A-B-C-D top lanes. Completing A-B-C-D once lights double bonus; completing it again alternately lights an outlane for the configured award. A side spinner or the upper center target opens the side gate, creating another route back to the top lanes.
strategy.simpleOverview: Shoot through the side spinner or hit the upper center target to open the side gate, then keep sending the ball to the top. Complete A-B-C-D once for double bonus and a second time to light an outlane for the configured award. Nudge at the top to finish missing letters.
strategy.summary: Keep the ball above the bumpers as long as possible. The spinner is both a repeatable score and a gate-control shot; top-lane nudging is more valuable than direct low-feature risk because A-B-C-D doubles the whole end-of-ball bonus.

quickInfo.name: Open Side Gate
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the spinner or hit the upper center target.

quickInfo.name: Build Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Use top lanes and repeated upper-playfield action.

steps.text: Shoot through the side spinner or hit the upper center target to open the side gate.
Use the gate and spinner routes to return the ball to the top lanes.
Complete A-B-C-D once to light double bonus.
Complete A-B-C-D again to light the configured outlane award, alternating sides.

alternatives.title: Upper-center route
alternatives.when: Use this when the spinner shot is not feeding the top cleanly.

steps.text: Hit the upper center target to open the side gate.
Use bumper action and nudging to collect missing top letters.
Return to the spinner only from a controlled flipper feed.
Build base bonus through lanes and upper-playfield switches.
Complete A-B-C-D once to light double bonus.
Protect the ball after both the base and doubler are valuable.

machineSetup: Test A-B-C-D, spinner, upper center target, side gate and return, bumpers, outlane lamps, bonus ladder, and all upper-playfield feeds shown on the factory playfield chart.
Confirm the outlane award, maximum one Extra Ball per ball, three- or five-ball rules, and whether the gate stays open and returns the ball consistently.
